info.title: abembed
info.description:
Embed proxy for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit and X/Twitter posts. Swap the platform domain in a post link for abembed to get a Discord embed.

Embed routes redirect browsers to the original post. Posts with a single image or video redirect straight to the media, other posts get a component embed. Reddit and X/Twitter posts always get the component embed. Prefix the domain with `f.` (for example `f.abinstagram.com`) to always get the component embed. Media and avatar routes redirect to fresh CDN urls, so links to them keep working after the CDN urls expire.

get.description:
`path` is a facebook.com post path. Supported shapes:

- `share/{code}`, `share/p/{code}`, `share/r/{code}`, `share/v/{code}`
- `reel/{id}`
- `watch?v={id}`, `video.php?v={id}`
- `photo?fbid={id}`, `photo.php?fbid={id}`
- `permalink.php?story_fbid={id}&id={id}`, `story.php?story_fbid={id}&id={id}`
- `groups/{group}/posts/{id}`, `groups/{group}/permalink/{id}`
- `{user}/posts/{id}`, `{user}/videos/{id}`, optionally with a slug before the id
- `{user}/photos/{album}/{id}`
- `stories/{bucket}/{story}`

Append `/media/{index}` to redirect to one of the post's media, or `/avatar` to redirect to the author's avatar.

Index.name: index
Index.description: Zero based position in the post's media

MediaLimit.name: media_limit
MediaLimit.description: Most media to include, across the post and the posts shown with it. Up to 10 the json fits a component embed. Above 10 it is for a bot's message instead: media fills galleries of 9, the last taking a tenth item rather than leaving it alone, and the text is cut to the 4000 characters a message allows rather than to the embed's 3000 bytes. Media that would take the message over 40 components is left out.

TikTokUsername.name: username
TikTokUsername.description: Author username, with or without the leading `@`. TikTok ignores it, so `@` alone also works

RedditSlug.name: slug
RedditSlug.description: Post title as in reddit links, only used as the title when the post's own can't be read

TwitterUsername.name: username
TwitterUsername.description: Any username works, the status id picks the post

Language.name: language
Language.description: Language to translate the text into, e.g. `en` or `pt-br`

DiscordEmbed.description: Component embed html for posts that don't redirect to their only media

Redirect.description: Redirect to the original post for browsers, otherwise to the post's only media

reply_to.description: X/Twitter only, the post this one replies to
